label: D2 only, not after a rewarded a2 trial; strongest after a loss / when policy is ambivalent
explanation: Fires exclusively at D2 (26% of D2 steps, never at D1/GO). Support is nearly fully bounded by: D2 where this trial chose a1 OR the previous trial was unrewarded (dev recall 0.999, mass 0.999); it essentially never fires at D2 after choosing a2 when the previous trial was rewarded. Precision is only ~0.40, so within that support it fires selectively. Magnitude: top quartile is ~98% prev_reward==0 (loss streaks, often a1->S1 common with repeated non-reward), and activity concentrates where the model policy logit at D2 is near zero (|choice|<3: F1 0.58, mass 0.89; adding it to the recorded predicate gives F1 0.63). Low-magnitude activations are a1->S1 rewarded streaks with good=S1. Rate rises over the episode. All variables used are observed at D2 (action is the in_action input).

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: phase=D2 & last=a1 S1 u (+5.34), phase=D2 & before=a1 S1 u (+3.79), phase=D2 & choice_bin=decile 6 (9 = most a1) (+2.44), stay=0 (+2.26), phase=D2 & choice_bin=decile 5 (9 = most a1) (+2.22), phase=D2 & before=a2 S1 u (+2.07). Lower it: in_state=0 (-5.36), in_action=0 (-4.81), phase=D2 & last=a1 S2 r (-4.68), last=a1 S2 r (-4.64).
